description: Card payments on a Lamoi shop (serviceId from oma_waas_sites). status (default): the payment account state: none (not started), needs_info (details missing), pending (being checked), live (payments and payouts on), payouts_paused (payments work, payouts held), rejected or disconnected; with the platform fee of the plan, open payment disputes, linkKind (created or oauth) and canLink (the owner may link a Stripe account they already have). sync true reads the account first. start (confirm): opens the secure sign-up for a new payment account (or continues it) and returns a one-time link; have the bank account (IBAN), an ID document and the business ID ready (a private person uses their own details). link (confirm): the owner already has a Stripe account: returns the sign-in link where they pick it; only before a new account has any details. methods: every payment method with its real status (on, off, pending, needs_info, activate = the owner turns it on in their own Stripe settings, unavailable, unsupported = PayPal, which Stripe does not offer to shops with their own account) and whether it can be switched here. method_set (confirm; method = apple_pay, google_pay, link, klarna, mobilepay, revolut_pay or sepa_debit, on = true or false): shows or hides that method at the shop's checkout. Cards are always on. No keys are ever shown or pasted.

action.description: status (default) and methods are reads; start (new account), link (the owner's existing Stripe account) and method_set need confirm.

method.description: method_set: the payment method to show or hide at checkout (cards are always on).

on.description: method_set: true shows the method at checkout, false hides it.

serviceId.description: The Lamoi site's service id (from oma_waas_sites).

sync.description: status: read the account from the payment provider first. methods: false gives the last stored status.

name: oma_waas_payments
title: Lamoi shop card payments
